name: slack-bot
description: Mounts `crtr slack-bot` — posts Slack messages as a bot user (DMs, group DMs, channels, thread replies) so the people addressed are notified, using SLACK_BOT_TOKEN set at install or with `crtr sys env set --name SLACK_BOT_TOKEN`.

SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.description: Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-…) of the Slack app the bot posts as. Needs bot scopes chat:write, chat:write.public, im:write and mpim:write.
